title: /workers page: stale copy naming only Kokoro/Qwen for the Batch GPU queue
description:
console/app/workers/page.tsx (line ~61) says "The cloud fallback queue
executes Kokoro and Qwen on EC2 G4dn.xlarge GPU instances via Step
Functions when local workers are unavailable" -- confirmed stale/wrong
by checking cdk/stacks/backend.py: there is only ONE Batch job definition
and ONE compute environment (single instance_types=["g4dn.xlarge"], one
GPU ResourceRequirement) shared by every backend, not just Kokoro/Qwen.
Confirmed empirically too: Fish, Higgs, Chatterbox, and F5 jobs all ran
through AWS Batch in production on 2026-09-16/17 (see also auritus-a99ed6
for the discovery that some of those didn't produce real audio, but they
did go through the same Batch queue/instance type).

Likely leftover copy from before Fish/Higgs/Chatterbox/F5 backends were
added. Fix: update the copy to not name only two backends, e.g. "The
cloud fallback queue executes any configured TTS backend on EC2
G4dn.xlarge GPU instances via Step Functions when local workers are
unavailable."
